entities.summary: The Choto Shona Mosque is a 15th-16th-century mosque located in Chapai Nawabganj district, in the Rajshahi Division of Bangladesh. Situated about 3 kilometres (1.9 mi) south of the Kotwali Gate and 0.5 kilometres (0.31 mi) to the south-east of the Mughal Tahakhana complex in the Firozpur Quarter, the mosque is often referred to as "gem of Sultanate architecture" and "gem of Gaur".
